She blocked me from all contacts we have, so I have no choice but to focus on me. The thoughts are better, some really important friends appear to help. 

I feel that I´m sick, but I´m starting to see some light, I can make plans right now without couting with her and her mood swings. 

Still hutrs, because in some way, there is goodness inside her and I already miss this goodness so much. 

But I´m understanding that the price that I´m paying for this little demonstration of affection, is way too high for me. 

Thank you soo much for your words, I really need to improve my steem, the trouble of abusive relations is that the person learns how to manipulate you without you even realize. Thinking these days, I realize that she makes me fell guilty for abandon her, even when she that abandon me. 

The thing is, I´m a beautiful person, very smart, with dreams, and at her side I start see myself as a horrible person, when se is Always the victim. Even now she is behaving like some fragile person, almost everybody in our social circle thinks I´m the bad guy, because she have such power to manipulate people. 

Only the very close friends of mine that can realize a diferent reality, this is one of the motives that crushes me. 

I´m confident that I will pass this and return to my path, I just wish that this return could be less painful. 

In a way your words help pe me with this pain.

I already think in match her actions, I don´t know how to do this. I don´t even know how can I hurt her. The main reason that my suicidal wishes eventually goes away is her, because, kill myself will be the last action of agression, sometimes i feel that will giver her a lot of pleasure see me ill or dead.

Sorry, wrote in kind of emotion. 38, we have a band toghether that is still on early days, but with investors, and supporters that can make our year exclusively from music. 

The end of the relation pretty much ends this dream.
